'''''Hibiscus'' × ''archeri''''', the '''red hibiscus''', is an [[Hybrid (biology)|artificial hybrid]] species of flowering plant in the family [[Malvaceae]].<ref name="PoA_0-793" >{{cite web |url=http://www.plantsofasia.com/index/hibiscus_x_archeri/0-793 |title=''Hibiscus'' × ''archeri'' (Гибискус Арчера) |author=Marina Khaytarova |date=2025 |website=Trees of Tropical Asia |publisher=plantsofasia.com |access-date=15 March 2025 |quote=Archer's Hibiscus, Red Hibiscus }}</ref> Its parents are ''[[Hibiscus schizopetalus]]'' and ''[[Hibiscus × rosa-sinensis]]'' (itself a hybrid).<ref name="POWO_559944-1" >{{cite POWO |id=559944-1 |title=''Hibiscus'' × ''archeri'' W.Watson |access-date=15 March 2025 }}</ref> A shrub or small tree, there appear to be a number of cultivars.<ref name="PoA_0-793" />
